name: naungan-demo-video
description: The narrated live demo (web/public/demo.mp4): Playwright records every feature on the live site, Remotion composes it with captions and an AI voice

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Demo out/demo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 23
scripts.web: ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/demo.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 30 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 96k -movflags +faststart ../web/public/demo.mp4 && ffmpeg -v error -y -ss 9 -i ../web/public/demo.mp4 -frames:v 1 -q:v 4 ../web/public/demo-poster.jpg && node srt.mts
scripts.all: npm run capture && npm run render && npm run web
